name: Sarah Pollard
tagline: Top rated Family Law attorney in Cypress, Texas
education: South Texas College of Law Houston
about: The owner and managing attorney of The Pollard Firm, PLLC, in Cypress, Texas, Sarah Pollard provides diligent legal representation and counsel to clients facing tumultuous family law matters, including divorce and separation, child custody and support, adoptions, enforcement and modifications, protective orders and paternity, among many others.

Ms. Pollard completed her undergraduate studies in 2012, graduating with her Bachelor of Arts degree in international and global studies from Baylor University. She went on to attend the South Texas College of Law, Houston, where her legal acumen and talents were evident throughout her time there, laying the legal bedrock of her practice that still informs her today. She received her Juris Doctor in 2015, and a year later, she obtained her license to practice law in Texas.

A stalwart advocate for her clients through all the trials and tribulations of their legal issues, Ms. Pollard strives to provide them with relief and respite during this trying time, taking on the brunt of their legal burdens while they focus on themselves and their loved ones. For her many contributions, she holds a “Good” rating on Avvo and hosts myriad positive client testimonials on the site as well.

Outside her law practice, Ms. Pollard maintains close affiliations with many prominent legal organizations to promote her standards of client care within her legal community, including holding memberships in the Houston Trial Lawyers Association and the Houston Young Lawyers Association. Within the Houston Bar Association, she is a member of the Lawyers for a Beautiful Houston Committee and the Lawyers for Literacy Committee.
